stem: Based on this photograph, which statement explains one geographical impact of the use of technology during the Klondike Gold Rush?

options.label: A
options.text: It increased the biodiversity of habitats.

options.label: B
options.text: It increased the possibility of soil erosion.

options.label: C
options.text: It improved the possibility of disaster recovery.

options.label: D
options.text: It improved the ecosystem of water environments.

visual_elements: This photograph shows a geographical impact during the Klondike Gold Rush of 1897–1898. A steamboat pulls up to the riverbank, ready to load up many cords of wood to continue its journey.
